refs.name: spoon_exterior
refs.note: a small ramen shop on a rainy back street at night, a pink neon sign reading "Midnight Spoon", red paper lanterns, glowing vending machines beside the door

refs.name: spoon_interior
refs.note: a narrow ramen counter with six stools, steam rising from copper pots, handwritten paper menus on the wall, warm yellow lamps

shots.text: A wide static shot of @spoon_exterior in the rain. Neon light from the sign ripples across the wet street.

@mika runs into frame from the left, holding the messenger bag over her head, and stops under the awning. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she shakes the rain from her sleeves.
A close-up of @mika looking up at the sign, rain dripping from the edge of the awning in front of her face.

Inside @spoon_interior, @ren stands behind the counter, lifting noodles from a pot with long chopsticks, steam curling around the chrome arm. The door slides open behind the counter and @mika steps in.
A medium shot of @mika sliding onto a stool and dropping the wet bag beside her. She grins.
A close-up of @ren setting a steaming bowl down in front of her. The camera holds a static shot as the steam rises.
